Game Overview

In Space Invader, the core idea is straightforward: pilot your spacecraft through intense cosmic battles in Space Invader. Strategically upgrade your arsenal to defeat cunning alien formations. With vibrant visuals and pulse-pounding sound, each level challenges your reflexes and strategy. Shoot, dodge, and survive to become the galaxy’s ultimate defender, all while navigating ever-complex enemy tactics.
